name: Sailing and Boats
description: Deep Seas also includes Create High Seas: surface ships.

pages.title: Sailing and Boats
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Surface ships are the same physical vessels as submarines, but float and travel by wind, engine or oar.
- A ship needs **enough canvas** for its size. Steer along the Wind Vane's arrow for top speed.
- A **Rudder** at the stern tells sails which way is forward.

Deep Seas also includes **Create High Seas**: surface ships. They are the same kind of physical vessel as a [#](2E5AAC)[submarine](entry://ocean/submarines)[#](), but they float on top and travel by wind, engine or oar.

pages.title: Sail
pages.text: Comes in all 16 dyes. A ship needs enough canvas for its size, and big ships need more sails to get going.

pages.title: Wind Vane
pages.text: Shows wind direction. Steer along the arrow for top speed. [#](2E5AAC)[Goggles](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() show alignment as a percent.

Wind has a baseline, gusts, and extra strength in rain and thunderstorms.

- Terrain upwind can block it.
- Sailing straight into the wind keeps only part of your speed.
- A **Rudder** at the stern tells sails which way is forward; mount it on a [#](2E5AAC)[Swivel Bearing](entry://flight/ship_building)[#]() to steer.

pages.title: Boat Engine
pages.text: A compact fuel-burning propeller. Mount it at the stern with the propeller in the water.

The engine burns fuel (open its fuel screen to see what it takes).

- **Right-click** to take the tiller, **sneak** to let go.
- **Sneak-click** for the fuel screen.
- **Hold use** at the helm and move the mouse to set a speed limit from 0 to 15.

pages.title: Anchor
pages.text: Light in the air, one ton once it touches the bottom. Use a Steel Cable on it to connect a rope winch.
**Oars** give a stroke forward when used near water. A **Buoy** is a towable float you can ride and skip across the surface. Dyed **Floaters** from Deep Seas keep a plain boat on the surface.

pages.title: Seaglide
pages.text: Handheld twin fans for swimming. Runs on your hunger, not fuel. Break the surface at speed to leap out.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** **Steel Cables** and **Pulleys** let a ship ride a cable. An **Arresting Hook** under a ship grabs a cable and brakes it, like a carrier landing. An **Underwater Mine** on a [#](2E5AAC)[contraption](entry://create_basics/contraptions)[#]() detonates when entities or boats come close.
